name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.teamkit.ui.normal.activity.TeamSettingActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin TeamKit Activity opens a team chat’s settings page, with controls for chat notices, muting and pinning, team details, members, and manager settings. Owners can also leave or dismiss the team from the available controls.
disableEffect: Users lose this page’s team-chat settings and its shortcuts to member, manager, and team details.
